span.p:
CLASSICAL
• Signing: RS256 (RSA-2048),
ES256 (P-256), EdDSA (Ed25519)
• KEM: RSA-OAEP, ECDH (P-256), X25519
• Hashing: SHA-256 / 512, Argon2id

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
POST-QUANTUM (NIST FIPS)
• Signing: ML-DSA-65, ML-DSA-87, SLH-DSA
• KEM: ML-KEM-768, ML-KEM-1024
• Hashing: SHA3-256 / 512

div.style: display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center;

span.p:
HYBRID (BSI recommended)
• Signing: RS256 + ML-DSA,
ES256 + ML-DSA
• KEM: X25519 + ML-KEM

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
CONFIG-DRIVEN ALGORITHM SELECTION
PEZHWAN_JWT_SIGNING_ALGORITHM =
RS256 | ES256 | EdDSA | ML-DSA-65 | ML-DSA-87 |
hybrid-RS256-MLDSA65 | hybrid-ES256-MLDSA65
PEZHWAN_KEY_ENCAPSULATION_ALGORITHM =
RSA-OAEP | ECDH | ML-KEM-768 | ML-KEM-1024 |
hybrid-X25519-MLKEM768
NO ALGORITHM LITERALS ANYWHERE IN APPLICATION CODE

span.p:
Rules
• Only ACTIVE signs
• Only non-revoked keys appear in JWKS
• PQC keys stay VERIFY-ONLY for the max token lifetime (30 days)
• Hybrid keys rotate classical and PQC atomically

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
HSM / KMS BACKENDS
• PKCS#11 (AWS CloudHSM, Thales, nCipher)
• AWS KMS / Azure Key Vault / GCP KMS
• Private key never leaves the HSM
